coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Matches 3 of 11 ground-truth variable items (27%): comparison of ZB-2p with a theoretical schedule, ideal communication overlap, and empirical bubble rate. Other items are missing, only partially represented, or contradicted.
coverage.design_error_analysis: Substitutes 7B/70B models for the specified 14.6B model, varies pipeline depth instead of fixing 16 stages, and varies microbatch counts instead of fixing 64. The general 2p setting does not reproduce the fixed ENABLE_ZERO_BUBBLE=1 and ZERO_BUBBLE_MEM_LIMIT=32 configuration. Nsight is included, but nsys export and custom Python/SVG processing are absent. MFU replaces samples/second/GPU throughput, and aggregate theoretical-gap analysis does not measure computed-versus-profiled stage timeline alignment. Numerous additional experimental factors change the intended controlled design.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion_output is empty, so it does not semantically match the expected conclusion.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: No conclusion is supplied predicting near-zero bubbles, typically below 1%, with minor practical overheads and supporting high throughput and tight timeline alignment. The conditional discussion embedded in design_output also uses a different 3% success threshold.
